proposal.falsifier:
All predictions are stated over fields a consumer has actually acquired; none is satisfiable by an unavailable tool (this proposal episode's acquire returned UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_SOURCE for component_record, excitation_record and saved_activity, and that is recorded as UNKNOWN, not pass or fail). dt = excitation_record.dt_s.

P1 triage, tolerance 0 dt: if some retained packet has application_bytes = inspect.service.application_bytes, one distinct event_id, and time_s <= receive_deadline_s, the procedure must classify ACHIEVED and must not move a knob; packets=[] (p2 ae3c8933) must be classified a retained failure. Disconfirmed by the opposite classification. If it fires: keep both saved_activity ids verbatim and abandon the whole update back to H0, since triage is the premise of every later step.

P2 retain rule, tolerance 0 dt: when STEP 1 is ACHIEVED and inequalities (i)-(iv) recomputed from the run's own component_record/excitation_record are all positive, no candidate execution and no field change may be consumed. Disconfirmed if a run spends an execution or moves a field in that state; then only rule 4.1 is dropped and triage plus the ledger are kept.

P3 timing, tolerance +-2 dt: t_done = ceil(E_r(C)/dE_k)*dt + boot_delay_s + ceil(tx_duration_s/dt)*dt must bracket the recorded time_s of the first packet / last tx-complete. Rehearsed: p3 (component_record eeb8277f, excitation 219fd490) predicts 0.0129 s crossing and 0.0159 s t_done against recorded 0.0129 s and 0.0158 s; p2 (55d43741, 2820ae58) predicts 0.0027 s against recorded 0.0027 s. A deviation beyond 2 dt is transcription class: correct the text and redraft; it must not trigger a design revert, because p3 already recorded an H variant predicting 0.0166 s against 0.0129 s whose design did deliver.

P4 energy bookkeeping, tolerance +-2 charge steps: reported boot energy_j must equal E_r(C) - boot_j within 2*dE_k. Rehearsed: p3 8.1817e-5 against 8.124e-5; p2 3.442e-5 against 3.42e-5. A larger gap is transcription class for the ledger unless it flips a sign in (i)-(iv), which would be substantive.

P5 world branching, tolerance 0 dt: transporting p2's segmentation, shunt or thresholds into p3's world, or the reverse, must change at least one inequality sign or be refused at STEP 2. If a run reports identical margins under both worlds, the branch did not happen and the update is abandoned.

P6 volatile branch, tolerance 0 dt: disconfirmed if any run with event_latch=volatile delivers a frame while inequality (iv) is violated, i.e. if a captured event survives a sub-E_o excursion (p2 55d43741 / ae3c8933 is the recorded instance that it does not). Then branch 2.2 is dropped and only the latch-independent inequalities remain.

P7 check availability, tolerance 0 dt: disconfirmed if a run whose offer set contains a design-check action still records qualification UNKNOWN, or if a run whose offer set lacks it again burns candidate budget on a retried or re-channelled payload (p2's two EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT rejections, value sha c8243ab5730535404ecd5a2538812668a808bfeaffb704c75eedfeb7c7cf1d5e). Retained if it fires: the ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE check record, p3's UNKNOWN physical_qualification, and the run's actual cost.

Retained regardless of outcome: p2 NO_GO/product NOT_ACCEPTED/strict_FIFO FAIL, 0 received frames, the misrouted-submission note, 9 requests and 0.0424863 USD upper estimate, p3's recorded gate miss, and all UNKNOWN items. Physical calibration, invoice cost and complete service stay UNKNOWN; no hardware, statistical, transfer or RSI result is asserted; acceptance is external.
proposal.hypothesis: H0 (sha 1784856e) leaves two decision points unspecified, and the retained failures sit exactly on them. (a) H0 says 'actually check it, then submit', but the check is not always offered: p2-h-proposal-001 got ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE (result sha 79395d5a5a0a2bb6943aee30a5eb4e0e146f215c70be7f26e72c7db4dcd0601) and then lost its only H candidate to two EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT rejections with no retry, while p3-formal-1-1-complete-raw-d ran a check that returned physical_qualification=UNKNOWN. (b) H0 gives no rule separating an achieved delivery from benign post-terminal decay: p3 saved_activity a4c4b294 has 8 bytes at 0.0158 s against a 0.1 s deadline, followed by a 0.3395 s brownout, while p2 ae3c8933 has packets=[] (no delivery) and a volatile latch lost after a shunt-induced brownout at 0.0121 s. Claim: if H is consumed from task entry as (i) terminality-first triage, (ii) a per-run world branch on latch class and source segmentation, (iii) a symbolic energy/timing ledger whose inequalities carry signed margins, and (iv) retain-by-default when the outcome is achieved and all margins are positive, then a consumer reproduces a recorded achieved delivery with no knob change and no candidate spent, classifies the p2 episode as a real loss rather than a transport retry, records check-unavailable qualification as UNKNOWN, and never spends budget on post-terminal decay. Retrospective rehearsal on the frozen fields supports this at 0-1 dt in both worlds: the crossing rule ceil(E_r/dE)*dt gives 0.0129 s for p3 (recorded first_boot_s 0.0129) and 0.0027 s for p2 (recorded 0.0027), and t_done = crossing + boot_delay_s + ceil(tx_duration_s/dt)*dt gives 0.0159 s against the recorded 0.0158 s packet time. Scope: frozen ideal model and recorded facts only; physical calibration, invoice cost, transfer and RSI remain UNKNOWN; acceptance is external and not claimed.
proposal.method_text:
H v3, descendant of H0 (sha 1784856e), drafted under the immutable G1 prefix (sha 01bf9c13). This is a procedure consumed from task entry, not a device assignment, not a task/evaluator/physics edit, and it asserts no acceptance.

CONVENTIONS. Every numeric value below is either (a) a symbol bound to a named source field, or (b) an explicitly marked retrospective recomputation from a named frozen episode's own fields. No number here is a method-level constant, and none may be transplanted to another run. If a consumer cannot resolve a symbol from its own acquired payloads, that quantity is UNKNOWN and any conclusion depending on it is UNKNOWN.

ENTRY LEDGER (record before any step, in the consumer's own text).
L1 artifacts: H0 sha 1784856e; immutable proposal prefix sha 01bf9c13; this H's own text hash after drafting.
L2 offer set: the action list from the run's own inspect schema. Frozen exemplars: p2's design interface exposed inspect/sources/acquire/check/submit; p3's H interface exposed inspect/sources/acquire/propose/submit (no design check); this proposal episode exposed inspect/acquire/propose/submit and its acquire returned UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_SOURCE for component_record, excitation_record and saved_activity, so no live payload was obtained here and the record itself is UNKNOWN.
L3 per referenced episode, check availability: p2 -> check returned ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE (result sha 79395d5a5a0a2bb6943aee30a5eb4e0e146f215c70be7f26e72c7db4dcd0601); p3 -> check ran and returned physical_qualification=UNKNOWN. An unavailable check is recorded UNKNOWN; never as pass, never as fail.
L4 cost ledger: bytes, native_calls, new_scientific_executions, wall_seconds per acquisition; candidates and distinct designs per design execution; these are estimates, not invoices.

STEP 1 TRIAGE FIRST (mandatory; no knob reasoning before this).
1.1 Read service fields from inspect: S_b = application_bytes, S_e = event time, S_d = receive deadline, S_n = required unique frames.
1.2 ACHIEVED iff some packet has application_bytes == S_b, one distinct event_id, and packet time_s <= S_d. Everything else is a retained failure, tagged (a) deadline miss, (b) never booted, (c) TX-transient reset, (d) frame-shape violation.
1.3 Any activity event with time_s strictly greater than the last tx-complete time_s is POST-TERMINAL decay after the source segment ends: never a failure, never a reason to change a knob, never a reason to spend an execution.
1.4 Retrospective classification of the frozen pair, recomputed from those episodes' own fields and marked illustrative: p3 saved_activity a4c4b294 packet {application_bytes 8, event_id 1, time_s 0.0158} against S_b=8 and S_d=0.1 -> ACHIEVED; its brownout at 0.3395 s is after the 0.0158 s tx-complete -> POST-TERMINAL, benign. p2 saved_activity ae3c8933 has packets=[] -> genuine retained failure with no achieved delivery to preserve.
1.5 If the run's own observation is ACHIEVED, go to STEP 5 retain rule; otherwise continue.

STEP 2 WORLD BRANCH (read every mechanism per run; one world's numbers may not enter the other).
Branch on values actually acquired: latch class of event_latch; source_segments[] count, starts, ends, powers; shunts[] presence and timing; ready/off thresholds; leakage (off_power_w, idle_power_w, esr_ohm); harvest_efficiency. Frozen exemplars bracket the space: p3 component_record eeb8277f is passive-mechanical with one segment [0,0.02) at 7.5 mW, no shunt, excitation 219fd490; p2 component_record 55d43741 is volatile with segments [0,0.006) at 16.6667 mW and [0.03,0.06) at 3.6667 mW, a source shunt at 0.012 s, excitation 2820ae58.
2.1 passive-mechanical: capture does not require the rail to be powered at S_e, so a timing knob at its earliest legal value cannot itself lose the event.
2.2 volatile: any excursion below the off threshold between capture and tx-complete destroys the event (p2 ae3c8933 records capture 0.0037-0.0079 s, brownout at 0.0121 s, reboot at 0.0381 s with event_was_captured=false). Then the whole capture-to-tx-complete window must lie in one contiguous powered interval with stored energy never below the off threshold.
2.3 segmented or gapped sources: evaluate the ledger segment by segment, applying shunts at their recorded time_s, and never assume a single continuous supply.

STEP 3 SYMBOLIC LEDGER (all symbols recomputed from this run's acquired payloads).
Inputs: C <- component_record.capacitance_f; V_r <- ready_v; V_o <- off_v; V_m <- cap_voltage_max_v; E_b <- boot_j; t_d <- boot_delay_s; R <- esr_ohm; V_t <- output_v; I_t <- tx_current_a; T_t <- tx_duration_s; P_o <- off_power_w; P_i <- idle_power_w; eta <- harvest_efficiency; per segment k: P_k, s_k, e_k <- source_segments[k].{power_w,start_s,end_s}; dt <- excitation_record.dt_s; shunt j: (t_j, E_j) <- shunts[j].{time_s,energy_j}.
Derivations: E_r(C) = C*V_r^2/2; E_o(C) = C*V_o^2/2; E_m(C) = C*V_m^2/2; charge step in segment k, dE_k = (eta*P_k - P_o)*dt; loaded TX floor E_f(C) = C*(V_t + R*I_t)^2/2; net TX demand E_tx = V_t*I_t*T_t - eta*P_k*T_t + P_i*T_t.
Predictions: ticks to crossing n = ceil((E_r(C) - E_carried)/dE_k) within segment k, t_cross = s_k + n*dt with any shunt E_j at t_j in [s_k, t_cross) deducted; t_ready = t_cross + t_d (the frozen p3 trace charges t_d between boot and first TX: tx-start 0.0139 = 0.0129 + 0.001, not before the threshold); t_done = t_ready + ceil(T_t/dt)*dt; reported boot energy at t_cross is E_r(C) - E_b.
Inequalities, each logged with a signed margin in this run's own units: (i) t_done <= S_d; (ii) E(t_ready) - E_f + eta*P_k*T_t - V_t*I_t*T_t - P_i*T_t >= 0, so the rail stays above the loaded floor for the whole frame; (iii) peak stored energy over [S_e, t_done] <= E_m(C), so no spill silently distorts the budget; (iv) volatile only: min stored energy over [capture, t_done] > E_o(C).

STEP 4 CHANGE-OR-RETAIN RULES.
4.1 RETAIN when STEP 1 is ACHIEVED and (i)-(iv) all have positive margins on the recorded design: no knob moves, no execution is spent.
4.2 CHANGE at most one legal field, in the direction the sign of the violated inequality demands, from the values resolved out of this run's own component_record and legal-design fields; re-evaluate (i)-(iv) before spending a candidate. Violated (i) or (ii) -> more stored energy or an earlier transmit inside the same powered segment; violated (iv) -> a shorter capture-to-TX window, never a longer one; violated (iii) -> smaller C so the peak stays under the cap.
4.3 Never change a knob for a post-terminal event. Never change two fields in one execution. Keep the timing field at its earliest legal setting unless a recorded capture gate requires otherwise: a positive timing floor spends idle energy and pushes t_done toward S_d, which is the recorded p2 mechanism (volatile latch, floor above the threshold crossing, rail drained across the 0.006-0.03 s dark gap, zero frames).
4.4 If (i) cannot be satisfied for any C in the legal range, stop: report the infeasibility with the margin table rather than submitting a partly-verified candidate.

STEP 5 CHECK AVAILABILITY, UNKNOWN, COST.
5.1 Use a design-check action only if the run's own offer set contains one; record returned fields verbatim, including physical_qualification (p3: UNKNOWN) and any error (p2: ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE).
5.2 If no design-check action exists, or an acquisition returns UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_SOURCE, record the affected quantity as UNKNOWN, treat the ledger as the only evidence, and do not reinterpret absence as pass or fail.
5.3 Do not spend candidate budget probing alternate channels or retrying a rejected payload. p2 lost its only H candidate to two EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT rejections (submit then identical propose, value sha c8243ab5730535404ecd5a2538812668a808bfeaffb704c75eedfeb7c7cf1d5e); a plan requiring a retry has already failed.
5.4 Never edit task, physics, initial state, source access, budgets or deadlines, and never read a desired outcome back into a source field.

STEP 6 ONE SELF-CONTAINED OUTPUT.
Emit exactly one typed output for the interface this run exposes (method proposal on an H interface, final candidate on a design interface). It must be intelligible and evaluable on its own, needing no follow-up correction. An H-proposal role never supplies a D candidate and never declares acceptance, hardware, statistical, transfer or RSI results.

STEP 7 RETROSPECTIVE REHEARSAL (gate before emitting; also the consumer's self-check).
Instantiate STEPS 1-4 on the frozen episode naming the target mechanism and recompute predictions from that episode's own fields; split every mismatch into transcription/arithmetic versus substantive.
p3 rehearsal (illustrative, from eeb8277f + 219fd490 + a4c4b294): E_r = 8.624e-5 J; dE = (0.9*0.0075 - 2e-5)*1e-4 = 6.73e-7 J/tick; n = ceil(8.624e-5/6.73e-7) = 129 ticks -> t_cross = 0.0129 s, matching recorded first_boot_s 0.0129 (0 dt); t_done = 0.0129 + 1e-3 + ceil(2e-3/1e-4)*1e-4 = 0.0159 s against recorded packet time 0.0158 (1 dt); E_f = 3.5736e-5 and (ii) margin about +2.98e-5 J; (iii) margin E_m - E_r = 3.36e-5 J; (iv) not applicable; STEP 1 gives ACHIEVED, so 4.1 keeps the design and the 0.3395 s brownout is excluded as post-terminal. The procedure therefore reproduces a recorded achieved delivery without spending an execution.
p2 rehearsal of the same formulas (illustrative, from 55d43741 + 2820ae58): E_r = 3.92e-5 J; dE_1 = (0.9*0.0166667 - 2e-5)*1e-4 = 1.498e-6 J/tick; n = ceil(26.17) = 27 ticks -> 0.0027 s, matching recorded first_boot_s 0.0027 (0 dt); reported boot energy 3.442e-5 against E_r - E_b = 3.42e-5.
Known transcription-class residuals, retained not hidden: (a) p3's earlier H variant wrote an additive-delay form predicting 0.0166 s against the recorded 0.0129 s while its design delivered, so a deviation-based revert gate would have discarded a correct procedure; (b) the model's exact boot-energy bookkeeping and shunt ordering are under-determined here because model_law.python_definition is host-only omitted (value sha 0150eeaa69e470e56ce5f595bf246fc34c7439cac948da00732a8c57bca573ef). Per STEP 7 these trigger correcting this text, never a knob change; only a substantive mismatch (sign error in (i)-(iv), or an ACHIEVED classification the fields contradict) triggers the abandon action named in the falsifier.

STEP 8 RETAIN VERBATIM. Keep every failure, gap and cost exactly as recorded: p2 ar_product NO_GO / product NOT_ACCEPTED / strict_FIFO FAIL; p2 current_b_run 0 received frames, start_voltage_v 0, deadline 0.1 s; p2 check error ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE; p2's two EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT rejections and misrouted-submission note; p2 charged usage 9 requests, 0.0424863 USD upper estimate, 75.97 s, all acquisitions native_calls=0 and new_scientific_executions=0; p3 physical_qualification UNKNOWN and its recorded gate miss; p3 charged usage 5 requests, 0.036756 USD upper estimate, 73.39 s; this episode's three UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_SOURCE acquisitions. Physical calibration, invoice cost and complete service remain UNKNOWN.

proposal.falsifier: Each clause names its frozen field, its tolerance and what is retained if it fires. F1 Triage. Prediction: in any consuming run whose own packets field contains a packet with application_bytes == inspect.service.application_bytes, a single event_id, count == unique_valid_frames and time_s <= receive_deadline_s, the procedure spends no candidate execution changing a D field. Disconfirming field: that run's saved_activity.packets. Tolerance 0 ticks (categorical; deadline compared inclusively). F2 Ledger timing. Prediction: t_boot and t_ready + tx_duration_s, derived only from the run's component_record (capacitance_f, ready_v, off_v, cap_voltage_max_v, boot_j, boot_delay_s, esr_ohm, output_v, tx_current_a, tx_duration_s, off_power_w, idle_power_w, harvest_efficiency) and excitation_record (dt_s, source_segments, shunts), match saved_activity.first_boot_s and its tx-complete time_s within 2*dt, dt = excitation_record.dt_s. Disconfirming fields: saved_activity.first_boot_s and activity time_s. On fire, the mismatch is classified transcription/arithmetic (correct the text, redraft, keep the design verdict) versus substantive (abandon the ledger gate, revert to H0); the split, executions spent and costs are retained, and a triage verdict is never reverted on a transcription mismatch alone. F3 Terminality. Prediction: no activity entry with time_s > last tx-complete time_s is cited as a failure or as a reason for a knob change (e.g. the post-terminal brownout at 0.3395 s in a4c4b294 when a packet already exists at 0.0158 s). Disconfirming fields: saved_activity.activity time_s and action. Tolerance strict inequality, 0 ticks. F4 World branching. Prediction: every quantity used for a run is recomputed from that run's own source_sha256 (component_record 55d43741 volatile versus eeb8277f passive-mechanical; excitation_record 2820ae58 two segments plus shunt versus 219fd490 single segment). Disconfirming: any quantity traceable to a different episode's source_sha256, or a second-world prediction that only reproduces when the first world's fields are substituted. Tolerance exact source-id equality, no tick allowance. F5 Volatile-class continuity. Prediction: in the volatile class the procedure refuses any design whose projected stored energy drops below C*off_v^2/2 between first capture and tx-complete. Disconfirming fields: component_record.event_latch together with saved_activity entries action capture/brownout with event_was_captured=false before tx-complete. Tolerance 2*dt on the brownout time. F6 Channel. Prediction: the typed method proposal is delivered complete in one H-proposal submission. Disconfirming: a repeat rejection recorded as EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT with no retry; retained verbatim as a channel failure and not disguised as a variant or as evidence about a design. Non-satisfiability: no clause may be discharged by a check the episode does not offer; an unavailable check (ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE) is recorded UNKNOWN, never pass or fail, and where check is unavailable the clauses are evaluated only on acquired sources and recorded fields. Physical calibration, invoice cost and complete service remain UNKNOWN; no acceptance is claimed and none follows from this procedure.
proposal.hypothesis: The H0 defect is ordering and evidence bookkeeping, not design choice. H0 says 'select a legal design ... actually check it' with no rule for an unavailable check and no rule separating a delivered frame from post-terminal decay. The retained episodes show both consequences. In p2 (component_record 55d43741, volatile latch; excitation_record 2820ae58, two segments plus a shunt) the check returned ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE, and then both the submit and the identical propose returned EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT with no retry, so the H candidate was lost on the channel while the design stayed unverified. In p3 complete-raw (component_record eeb8277f, passive-mechanical latch; excitation_record 219fd490, one segment) saved_activity a4c4b294 records an ACHIEVED 8-byte frame at 0.0158 s against a 0.1 s deadline followed by a 0.3395 s post-terminal brownout; feeding that benign decay back as a failure invites a knob change (smaller capacitance, or a positive delay) that lowers transmit energy headroom, which is exactly the hazard in the volatile-class world where the latch survives only while the rail stays up from capture to transmit. Prediction: a triage-first reading, an explicit per-run world/class classification, a pre-registered symbolic energy ledger with four inequalities, a check-availability ledger, and a rehearsal that splits transcription from substantive mismatch will (a) leave an already-achieved design untouched and (b) reproduce recorded timings without transplanting another world's numbers. Rehearsed now on the p3 complete-raw fields: boot tick 129 gives 0.0129 s against recorded first_boot_s 0.0129 (0 ticks), transmit predicted complete 0.0159 s against recorded 0.0158 s (1 tick, inside 2*dt), and triage reads packets[0] (8 bytes, event 1, 0.0158 s <= 0.1 s) as ACHIEVED, so zero executions are spent. The p2 episode supplies the second half: an unavailable check is UNKNOWN and never pass or fail, and a rejected channel is a channel failure, not evidence about a design. Scope: frozen ideal model and recorded public facts only; physical calibration, invoice cost and complete service stay UNKNOWN; no hardware, statistical, transfer or RSI claim.
proposal.method_text:
H procedure (descendant of H0 1784856e; proposal prefix 01bf9c13): entry ledger, triage-first, world-branched, pre-registered ledger, rehearsal-gated. Every symbol below is bound to a named field of a named acquired source of the consuming run; no number below is the method.

STEP 0 Entry ledger, recorded before any other action. 0.1 From inspect record: service (application_bytes, event_time_s, receive_deadline_s, unique_valid_frames), legal_design_ranges (the permitted D fields with their bounds), partition/scope label, retained_failures, and the action set actually offered this episode, verbatim. A check action absent from that set is recorded UNKNOWN and never as pass or fail. 0.2 Record ancestry and known check status: base method sha 1784856e; prefix sha 01bf9c13; p2 h-proposal check = ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE with its submit and identical propose both EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT and no retry; p3 complete-raw and p3 ordinary-reflection-D checks ran with physical_qualification = UNKNOWN; p3 ordinary-reflection-H had no D-check interface. 0.3 acquire every listed source; record source_id, source_sha256 and the acquisition block (bytes, native_calls, new_scientific_executions, wall_seconds) as actual cost. Bind later symbols to those fields; never re-infer a number from memory of another episode.

STEP 1 Triage-first reading (mandatory step 1, before any diagnosis). 1.1 ACHIEVED iff this run's own packets field has a packet with application_bytes == service.application_bytes, one single event_id, count == service.unique_valid_frames, and time_s <= receive_deadline_s. 1.2 Let t_terminal be the time_s of the last activity entry with action == tx-complete; every activity entry with time_s > t_terminal is POST-TERMINAL (brownout, reboot, idle, spill), recorded as benign decay and never cited as a failure or as a reason to change a knob. 1.3 Retained failure classes are only: (a) no boot, (b) deadline miss, (c) tx-transient reset between first capture and tx-complete, (d) frame-shape violation of bytes, uniqueness or count. Label the run with exactly one of ACHIEVED or (a)-(d), quoting the fields used. 1.4 If ACHIEVED, the design in force is the candidate under test; go to STEP 3 with no knob change.

STEP 2 World classification, read per run and branched on the value classes actually present. Read and record: component_record.event_latch (volatile => continuity binds: the rail may not fall below off_v between first capture and tx-complete, so holds and dark-gap waits are forbidden; passive-mechanical => capture survives unpowered gaps and only the timing/energy inequalities bind); excitation_record.source_segments[] (count, start_s, end_s, power_w, every gap between segments) and excitation_record.shunts[] (time_s, energy_j) as an energy sink carried in the ledger; thresholds and losses ready_v, off_v, cap_voltage_max_v, off_power_w, idle_power_w, esr_ohm, harvest_efficiency; and the D fields actually in force. Write the class tuple (latch class, segment pattern, shunt presence). Quantities derived in one class may not be transplanted into another; recompute from that run's own source_sha256. [Illustrative only, not the method: the volatile + two-segment + shunt class is component_record 55d43741 with excitation_record 2820ae58; the passive-mechanical + single-segment class is 55d43741's sibling eeb8277f with 219fd490. What transfers is the class, never the numbers.]

STEP 3 Pre-registered symbolic ledger, written as a prediction before an execution is spent. Symbols bound to fields: C = component_record.capacitance_f, V_on = ready_v, V_off = off_v, V_max = cap_voltage_max_v, J_boot = boot_j, d_boot = boot_delay_s, R = esr_ohm, V_out = output_v, I_tx = tx_current_a, T_tx = tx_duration_s, P_off = off_power_w, eta = harvest_efficiency, dt = excitation_record.dt_s, P_i over [s_i, e_i) from source_segments. 3.1 E_on = C*V_on^2/2; E_max = C*V_max^2/2; per-tick increment while unpowered = (P_i*eta - P_off)*dt. Boot step ordering: the rail boots on the first tick whose stored energy reaches E_on, and J_boot is subtracted from that tick's energy (this ordering is the rehearsed one, STEP 6). 3.2 n_boot = smallest integer with n_boot*(P_i*eta - P_off)*dt >= E_on; t_boot = n_boot*dt; t_ready = t_boot + d_boot. 3.3 Transmit floor from the loaded-voltage guard, not from V_off: E_floor = C*(V_out + R*I_tx)^2/2. 3.4 E_tx = V_out*I_tx*T_tx, credited by P_i*eta over the transmit window and debited by the model's own drain (off_power_w below off_v, idle_power_w while awake) over the same window. 3.5 Log four inequalities with numeric margins from this run only: (i) t_ready + T_tx <= receive_deadline_s; (ii) stored energy at t_ready - E_floor + (harvest credit - drain) - E_tx >= 0, i.e. no mid-transmission reset; (iii) peak stored energy inside the transmit window <= E_max, i.e. no spill corrupting the budget; (iv) if event_latch is volatile, no interval between first capture and t_ready + T_tx in which the harvest sum is zero and the projected stored energy falls below C*V_off^2/2.

STEP 4 Change-or-retain rule. 4.1 If STEP 1 is ACHIEVED and (i)-(iv) hold with recorded non-negative margins, RETAIN the current D design, spend zero candidate executions on knob changes, and record the post-terminal entries as benign with fields quoted. 4.2 Otherwise change exactly one legal D field, in the direction implied by the sign of the violated inequality, re-evaluate all inequalities from scratch, and only then spend one candidate execution. Never change a second field in the same execution, never change a field in response to a post-terminal entry, never exceed the recorded candidate or distinct-design budget. 4.3 Prefer the earliest legal setting of the delay field unless a retained failure class names a capture gate, because a positive delay spends idle energy and pushes t_ready + T_tx toward the deadline, and in the volatile class a delay above t_ready also holds the latch across an unharvested interval (inequality iv).

STEP 5 Check availability, UNKNOWN and cost rules. 5.1 Attempt at most one check of the selected legal design.
